title: Storm Sorceress
description: A powerful female sorceress with long purple braided hair stands dynamically amid a swirling purple storm. She holds a glowing golden staff in her right hand while extending her left, surrounded by magical energy, lightning, floating symbols, and a vortex of clouds.
prompt: A beautiful female sorceress with long flowing purple braided hair and a golden circlet stands in the center of a dramatic purple storm vortex. She wears white and purple robes with gold accents and armored greaves. In her right hand she holds a glowing ornate golden staff with a swirling energy tip, while her left hand channels magic. The scene is filled with swirling white and purple energy trails, floating golden runes, lightning bolts, and dark purple clouds with a bright vortex opening above. Epic fantasy digital painting style with dynamic composition and magical atmosphere.
